title: A check whose end marks no judgeable outcome is dropped silently in engram_resolve_turn_checks_with_notices
outcome: When engram_check_command_outcome returns None for an in-turn check's end (for example an Unknown exit with no result lines), the holder gets an engram_unrecorded_check_line notice saying its end marks no result the host can judge, and the host logs it, as the carried path already does. The check is no longer skipped with a bare continue.
acceptance: A test ends an in-turn check with no judgeable outcome and shows the holder notice and no record.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
